description.en:
Plays a skill scene set up with CMND_INIT_SKILL_SCRIPT and the SetChrPrmDetailForSkillScript... / SetAvatarDetailForSkillScript helpers.
It lets the field camera run (clears OFF_RPG_CAMERA from the pause bits), hides the goal model created by StartScEvent (eventGoalMouseHdl), requests the scene with CMND_RUN_SKILL_SCRIPT and suspends: the scene plays and the script resumes after it. It then shows the skill map model if one is loaded (CMND_GET_WAZA_MAP_HANDLE), shows the goal again and restores the pause bits.
See CMND_RUN_SKILL_SCRIPT for how success and mapReverse can be overridden.
true to play the scene towards the other goal.
Stored as NO_TELOP (by its name, true skips the skill name caption).
